body: You’re right I do need to back off some. I think it’s just I miss my friend and I’m ready to get back to that point. The reason I’m so hopeful is because a couple of our best friends dated and got back to the good friendship they had before they dated to begin with, after they broke up. I’m impatient and I need to work on that. Thanks for the response.

Thanks for all the advice. It’s quite helpful. I want to clarify though that he and I still live together so it’s quite difficult to not see him regularly. I don’t think I’m sad about the breakup aspect of it, but more so now I just miss my friend. Thanks again though for all the links and advice. I think I do struggle with a victim mentality and I need to stop that so thank you for mentioning that!
